title: ApplicationPatch
description: ApplicationPatch represents the fields a user can modify

addons.description: List of addons enabled for the application

boot_activity.description: Name of the boot package for the version

features.description: List of features supported by the application

image.description: Base image id or name to use for the applicaiton

inhibit_auto_updates.description: Whether or not to auto update the application's base image

instance-type.description: Instance type to use for the application

manifest_version.description: Version of the manifest used to create the application

node_selector.description: List of tags for filtering the nodes to run the application on

services.description:
List of services exposed by the application that should be expose on the instance
For application version update, changing those values would trigger a new application version creation

tags.description: Tags to attach to the application

ApplicationBootstrap.description: ApplicationBootstrap describes the fields used to configure the application bootstrap

keep.description: List of files to keep after the bootstrap

ApplicationHooks.description: ApplicationHooks describes the fields used to configure the hooks of an application

timeout.description: Time limit to wait for the hook to complete before timing out

ApplicationResourcesPost.description: ApplicationResourcesPost represents the fields used to update an application resource

cpus.description: Number of CPUs required by the application

disk-size.description: Storage size required by the application

gpu-slots.description: Number of GPU slots required by the application

memory.description: Memory to be assigned to the application

vpu-slots.description: Number of VPU slots required by the application

ApplicationWatchdog.description: ApplicationWatchdog describes the fields used to update an application watchdog

allowed-packages.description: List of android packages to enable the watchdog for

disabled.description: Whether or not to enable the watchdog for the application

NetworkProtocol.description: NetworkProtocol describes a specific network protocol like TCP or UDP a ContainerService can use

NetworkServiceSpec.description: NetworkServiceSpec is used to define the user defined network services that should be opened on a container

expose.description:
Expose defines wether the service is exposed on the public endpoint of the node
or if it is only available on the private endpoint. To expose the service set to
true and to false otherwise.

name.description:
Name gives the container a hint what the exposed port is being used for. This
allows further tweaks inside the container to expose the service correctly.
Exampe: ssh

port.description: Port is the port the container provides a service on

port_end.description:
PortEnd is the end of the port range set for a service. If empty, only a
single port is opened

protocols.description: List of network protocols (tcp, udp) the port should be exposed for

VideoEncoderType.description: VideoEncoderType describes the type of a video encoder is used by an application
